test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electrician) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following types of wooden mallets are used for general purpose work such as flattening and bending?
solution:
**Flattening: **Flattening is the process of making a metal surface flat and even after it has been bent, twisted, or distorted.

**Bending: **Bending is the process of deforming a metal sheet along a straight line to obtain a desired angle or shape.

For general-purpose sheet-metal work such as flattening and bending:

 
• Standard wooden mallets are commonly used.
 
• They provide controlled force without damaging the metal surface.
 
• They help avoid marks, dents, or scratches, which can occur with steel hammers.
